title: Important Update: MCA Notifies Amendments to Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) Rules, 2026
content:
# Important Update: MCA Notifies Amendments to Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) Rules, 2026

Ek important update hai! Government ne Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 ko amend karne ke liye naye rules announce kiye hain. The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) has notified the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Amendment Rules, 2026, bringing significant changes to existing Ind AS.

Here are the key details:

*   **Notification Details:** These amendments are issued vide G.S.R. 725(E) and dated August 12, 2026.
*   **Legal Framework:** The rules amend the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015, under the authority of sections 133 and 469 of the Companies Act, 2013. The National Financial Reporting Authority (NFRA) was consulted for these amendments.
*   **Effective Date:** The amendments are effective from their publication date in the Official Gazette.
*   **Key Ind AS Affected:** Various Indian Accounting Standards have been updated, including Ind AS 101, 107, 109, 110, and 7.
*   **Scope of Amendments:** The changes cover aspects such as annual improvements, classification and measurement of financial instruments, hedge accounting, contingent contractual cash flows, and cash-flow reporting.
*   **Applicability:** Several of these amendments will apply to annual reporting periods beginning on or after April 1, 2026.
